_about: Display-only renames for public board data (DAN RULING t2812u, Thu Oct 1 6:26 PM CT). The source Google Calendar is never edited. Applied at build time by scripts/house/display-rename.mjs (kids-week.json, kids-data.js EMBEDDED, cal-live.json, next-up, pickup-chain, school-night) and scripts/cal-months.py (cal-months.json). Erin stays Erin.

renames.evidence: Source event 'Mom & Dad in KC' (Sep 11-14): 'Mom & Dad arriving with Dan on BNA->MCI ... continuing to Cleveland' = Dan's parents. 'Erin + Mom/Dad' events are the same visit.
Source event 'Mom birthday' (Dec 24). Not applied when the title names someone else's mom ("Riley's Mom birthday").

parentScrub._about: Not renames: other people's parents never appear on public data (standing rule). A parenthetical naming a parent is dropped; "Riley's mom" becomes "Riley's"; anything still naming a parent after that is not published (the item is dropped).

moneyScrub._about: Calendar labels on public month/day views carry no money (cal-months.py; display-rename.mjs --money). A parenthetical with a dollar amount is dropped, then any remaining amount. Only allowed dollar string on the wall (DAN RULING t2812u #1): Ainsley's babysitting tag.
